This plan assumes the two fast-floodwater roads are unusable, since a truck was swept off one this morning.

- **Car1:** Shivapuri shelter and Jwalamukhi care home are linked by a usable road, so car1 collects the four elderly residents and brings them back. That costs 36 minutes and avoids a 200-point deferral penalty.
- **Car2, first trip:** It picks up the injured woman and the elderly widow at Thakre care home, then the two shopkeepers at Syaphru village. It brings all four to Trishuli hospital. That costs 31 minutes.
- **Car2, second trip:** It picks up the three elderly residents at Belkot care home and the injured farmer at Bidur school, which is only a pickup point. It then returns to Trishuli hospital. That costs 70 minutes.
- **Deferred:** The four children at Benighat farm, the four shopkeepers at Kispang farm, the three adults at Kakani farm and the three adults at Kalika village have no usable road to an evacuation point. Their penalties are 240, 80, 60 and 60.

load car1 elderly 4
drive car1 jwalamukhi-care-home shivapuri-shelter
